title: About the Author
html:
Adewale Obadimu is an engineer and technical leader with experience across high-traffic consumer platforms, robotics, cloud-native infrastructure, and financial services. His work has included site reliability engineering, production incident response, observability, platform engineering, and the design of systems that operate under demanding traffic and dependency conditions.

He wrote Practical System Design from the perspective that architecture decisions become clearer when they are connected to what engineers eventually have to measure, diagnose, and operate in production. His approach draws on incident investigation, design review, and the practical work of turning production evidence into better engineering decisions.

Adewale enjoys teaching and building systems that solve practical problems. He also enjoys traveling, volunteering, and meeting people from different backgrounds.
